stage: Conventional control confirmation, not an innovation experiment
trigger: Candidate38 geometry control gained tiny+.376741pp and small_all+.329778pp versus frozen regret; native features failed their own matched controls. Continue the ordinary geometry signal without reviving native feature STOP.
sample: Exactly original128fit/64headholdout train images, original score>=.05 and native-association activity from candidate38. No new detector inference or independent detector test.
recipe: Geometry head is exactly candidate38 geometry132->32->4, normalization, targets, clipping, balanced two-group SmoothL1(beta.02), AdamW(.002,.0001),8epochs,batch512. Reuse seed0 checkpoint/predictions/metrics and reproduce all saved predictions exactly. If gates pass, fit seeds1/2 once. Do not tune any parameter.
bias_control: Ordinary globally constant four-coordinate correction, four zero-initialized logits with same .1*tanh bound, target/loss/batches/optimizer and8epochs. Fit seed0 first; only proceed if geometry beats it. Constant control tests whether a generic global box bias explains the geometry gain. Lower capacity is acknowledged, not treated as matched parameter count.
budget: At most two geometry heads plus three constant four-parameter controls. Zero image decode, detector forward or detector training. Evaluate at most three seeds on64 cached headholdout scenes. Failed seed0 stops repetitions.
decision_rule: Seed0 must pass all gates before seeds1/2. Final needs>=2/3 fully passing, mean tiny/smallAP versus regret and constant meeting gates, and everyseed allAP/FP guards. Otherwise STOP_THIS_ORDINARY_GEOMETRY_RESIDUAL_CONFIRMATION.
pass_action: Allow newly registered bounded official-validation confirmation of the conventional control, with frozen geometry head/association/readout and source hashes. Do not upgrade strong control before that. No detector retraining.
fail_action: Do not tune constants, normalization, features, bounds, thresholds or seeds. Do not relabel the native/shuffled arms as a successful innovation.
limits: Postselection of a conventional control after candidate38, repeated64 detector-training scenes, inherited uniform diagnostic ignore handling and COCO area protocol. Seed consistency is not independent data confirmation or novelty. Association comes from all native anchors, not only saved post-NMS detections.
